rules.statement: Agent Skills descriptions must be non-empty and no longer than 1024 characters.
The OpenAI skills adapter can disable implicit invocation with policy.allow_implicit_invocation=false; explicit invocation remains possible.
rules.scope: OpenAI skills adapter; not a universal host security boundary

rules.statement: Compare outputs with a skill against a no-skill baseline under matched task conditions and review outcome quality, not only structure.
rules.scope: CometWeb evaluation design; not evidence that a particular skill improves outcomes
